arguments.content:
102

The release adding the SessionStore adapter (v0.1.64) bundled Claude CLI 2.1.116; the release adding `terminal_reason` to ResultMessage (v0.2.126) bundled Claude CLI 2.1.218. 218 - 116 = 102 patch versions.
